phases.title: Source orientation
phases.output: Corpus inventory, chapter coverage, technique routing and initial design
phases.gate: Corrections and inspection limits remain visible

phases.title: Source binding
phases.output: Original return linkage, same-object status observation and an ordinary control
phases.gate: The historical comparison meets the binding packet’s claim-specific gate

phases.title: Ordinary-work proof
phases.output: Three-minute job; two viable plans; one capacity conflict and handoff
phases.gate: Players can explain the tradeoff and want to try another plan

phases.title: Structure comparison
phases.output: Test operating-campus and reconstruction-park versions of the same payment conflict
phases.gate: Players choose and explain consequences without confusing fiction with history

phases.title: Thin playable episode
phases.output: 12–15 minute loop with one conflict, one valid control and the historical comparison
phases.gate: State, identity and provenance stay clear; P1 covers the historical content used

phases.title: Campaign outline lock
phases.output: Sequence learning prerequisites, source anchors, permissions and endings
phases.gate: Each chapter adds a distinction and has adequate source coverage

phases.title: Game production
phases.output: Episodes, assets, software, saves, access and performance checks
phases.gate: Each scene passes source, semantic and gameplay review

phases.title: Game release preparation
phases.output: Audience edit, attribution, rights, packaging and distribution
phases.gate: Review findings resolved; version and source scope explicit
